verificationSeoDesc: Submit organization evidence for Admin review.
verificationIntro: Admin review is authoritative. Completing this form does not verify your organization.
cannotSelfApprove: Employers cannot approve their own verification.
mapsSupportingOnly: Google Maps or Business listings are supporting evidence only — they do not verify the organization.
plansUsageSeoDesc: Server-derived free job quota and policy.
plansUsageIntro: Private drafts are unlimited and free. Submitting a job for review consumes free quota when the organization is verified.
draftsDoNotConsume: Drafts do not consume quota and do not cost money.
activeLimitAtApproval: The active-job cap is enforced at approval, not while a listing is pending review.
quotaRuleDraft: Saving a private draft does not consume quota.
quotaRuleSubmit: Submitting or activating a free job for review consumes one free submission.
quotaRuleActive: A verified organization may have up to 5 active free jobs.
quotaRuleRolling: Up to 10 free submissions per rolling 30 days, and 1 per 24 hours.
quotaRuleVisibility: An approved free job may remain visible for up to 30 days.
billingSeoDesc: Employer payment history from Commerce contracts.
billingIntro: Paid activation uses the existing Commerce and payment provider contracts. Success is never fabricated.
guidelinesSeoDesc: How Employer hiring, quota, and verification work.
guidelinesIntro: Ordinary usage is explained here. You do not need to read the Terms & Conditions to post a job.
helpIntro: Shortcuts to ordinary hiring help. Contact support for account issues.
interviewsIntro: Scheduling happens on the candidate record. This list does not create a second interview system.
guideVerificationBody: Submit legal identity and evidence. Admin review decides the outcome. You cannot approve yourself. Maps listings are supporting evidence only.
guideFreeJobsBody: Verified organizations receive free submissions under the Free Beta policy. Unverified organizations cannot consume free publication quota.
guideDraftsBody: Private drafts are unlimited. They are not public and do not consume submission quota or payment.
guideQuotaBody: Submitting or activating a job for review consumes a free submission. Saving or editing a draft does not.
guideActiveLimitBody: At most 5 active free jobs. The cap is enforced when a job is approved, not while it waits in review.
guideRollingBody: 1 free submission per 24 hours and 10 per rolling 30 days. Remaining quota and the next reset are shown on Plans & Usage.
guideReviewBody: Publication requires Admin approval. Employers cannot mark a job approved, published, paid, or verified from the client.
guideDurationBody: An approved free job may stay visible for up to 30 days unless closed earlier.
guideRepostBody: Reopening or making a major change can require review again and may consume quota according to the same free policy.
guideOpeningsBody: New jobs require a whole number of openings between 1 and 10,000. Older jobs without this field show “Not specified” and are not auto-filled.
guideInternalExternalBody: Internal jobs collect applicants on Strideto. External jobs send candidates outside Strideto. External jobs never show fake internal applicant counts.
guidePipelineBody: Pipeline states are Employer/server authoritative. Students cannot set hiring states. Historical application snapshots do not change when a student later edits their profile.
guideInterviewsBody: Schedule interviews with an IANA timezone on the candidate record. Recruiter-only notes are not shown to students unless marked as candidate-visible.
guidePaymentsBody: Paid listing uses the existing Commerce contracts. If the provider is not configured, billing shows not_configured. There is no homemade escrow.
guideRefundsBody: Refund status is shown only when a Commerce refund record exists. Provider results are authoritative.
guideProhibitedBody: Fraudulent, misleading, or illegal listings are prohibited and may be rejected, suspended, or revoked by Admin review.
guidePrivacyBody: You may only see applicants for your own jobs. Vault contents, student budget, and copilot history are not available here.
guideSkillTrustBody: CLAIMED is not EVIDENCE_BACKED, and EVIDENCE_BACKED is not VERIFIED. Employers cannot verify applicants, invent scores, or set trust badges.
